description: Change some fields of your workspace's sales playbook and get back what pricing and negotiation now read from it. A field you send replaces the saved text, an empty string clears it, and a field you leave out is kept. Write numbers the way a person would ("15%", "$1,200/mo", "Net 30"): the answer says, field by field, what was read and what could not be. While the sales-playbook-pricing release is on, the maximum discount becomes a floor under every price your workspace is given and counter-offers carry the terms and voice. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

annualCommitment.description: The discount for a year or longer, for example "15% off annual prepay" or "2 months free". An empty string clears it.

companySize.description: Employee count or revenue range of the ideal customer. An empty string clears it.

geography.description: Target regions or markets. An empty string clears it.

industry.description: Target industries. An empty string clears it.

listPrice.description: The list price with a currency, for example "$1,200/mo". Discounts are taken from the request's own current price, or from this when a request has none. An empty string clears it.

maximumDiscount.description: The most ever given, for example "25% with VP approval". Becomes the floor: list price less this. An empty string clears it.

minimumCommitment.description: A term, amount or quantity, for example "12 months" or "10 seats". Below it only the standard discount applies. An empty string clears it.

painPoint1.description: The primary pain point the product solves, with its impact. An empty string clears it.

painPoint2.description: A secondary pain point and its business consequence. An empty string clears it.

paymentTerms.description: For example "Net 30", "annual prepay" or "monthly". Attached to every counter-offer. An empty string clears it.

pricingModel.description: Per seat, usage-based, flat fee, tiered or share of savings. An empty string clears it.

primaryValueProp.description: The value proposition, in your own words; counter-offer messages lead with it. An empty string clears it.

roiPromise.description: The improvement, saving or gain a customer can expect; counter-offer messages quote it. An empty string clears it.

standardDiscount.description: The discount allowed without approval, for example "10%". Below the minimum commitment only this is allowed. An empty string clears it.

volumeDiscounts.description: Tiers, for example "100+ seats 10%, 500+ seats 15%". A buyer at a tier gets it in the asking price. An empty string clears it.

name: update_sales_playbook
